title: Kaderblick Video Manager – docs.kaderblick.de

hero.heading: Kaderblick Video Manager
hero.lead: Kaderblick Video Manager is a standalone desktop application for repeatable football-video workflows. A workflow defines the source, processing steps, optional title card and delivery. Several workflows can be prepared and run together.

body:
Official documentation and downloads · GitHub project

Use the main window

  • New workflow: opens the graphical workflow editor.
  • Edit: opens the selected workflow’s source, processing, title-card and upload settings.
  • Copy: duplicates a selected workflow so that a similar job does not have to be built from the beginning.
  • Workflow: opens the graphical editor for the individual processing steps.
  • Remove: removes selected entries from the current workflow list.
  • Start and Cancel: start or stop the selected workflows.
  • Load and Save: open or store a complete workflow arrangement.
  • Shut down computer: allows the computer to turn off after all processing has finished.

The table shows each workflow’s name, source, processing chain, status, current job and duration. The log below records the running operations. The status bar shows the current step, total duration and overall progress.

Build a workflow

The editor contains the available nodes on the left, the canvas in the centre and the selected node’s settings on the right. Drag a node to the canvas, then connect its output to the next node’s input. The connections determine the processing order. Auto layout rearranges the existing nodes; Apply saves the workflow and closes the editor.

1. Choose the source

  • Files: adds individual recordings. Each file can receive its own output name, YouTube title, playlist and Kaderblick start offset.
  • Folder scan: processes matching files from a source folder. Define the filename pattern and, if needed, a destination folder and output prefix.
  • Pi camera: retrieves recordings from a configured camera device. Choose the local destination and whether successfully downloaded files may be deleted from the camera.

2. Define processing

Enable video conversion when the source needs another output format. Resolution, frame rate, format and quality setting affect processing time, file size and output quality. The audio section can combine a separate audio track, adjust volume and synchronise sound with the picture.

3. Configure the title card

An optional title card can display the club logo, home team, away team, competition, date and venue before the match video. Check the preview and spelling before starting the workflow.

4. Configure delivery

  • Create a YouTube version: produces an output intended for upload.
  • Upload to YouTube: uses the previously connected YouTube account and the configured title, playlist and visibility.
  • Add to Kaderblick: assigns the resulting video link to the selected match.

Run a workflow

  1. 1
    Save the workflow arrangement
    Use Save so that the same arrangement can be loaded again later.
  2. 2
    Select the required entries
    Mark the workflows that should be processed in this run.
  3. 3
    Start processing
    Choose Start and monitor status, current job, duration and the running log.
  4. 4
    Handle an interrupted run
    If the application asks during the next start, choose Continue to resume at the recorded state or Restart to process everything again.
  5. 5
    Check the result
    Verify the output files and, when enabled, the YouTube upload and assignment to the correct Kaderblick match.

Connection to Kaderblick

Kaderblick Video Manager prepares and delivers the video outside the website. The result then appears in the match’s video section in Kaderblick, where it can be aligned with the match timeline, events and analysis scenes.
